thread:
Anya: Quick sync — kicking off the 'signal-bridge' pilot for the Optimize toolkit. Goal: ship an MVP that delivers adaptive recommendations (batching/caching/quant profiles) + eval-triggered alerts for pilot customers. Need to agree scope, launch criteria, and owners. Thoughts?

Devin: +1. For MVP I propose: 1) per-route batching heuristic suggestions, 2) optional prefix KV caching recommendations, 3) quantization recommendation profiles (e.g., int8/ltq with expected quality delta), 4) eval-triggered alerting when quality/regression metrics cross thresholds. No automated runtime rollouts in MVP.

Julia: Sounds good. Proposed acceptance criteria: recommendations must show <=5% quality delta vs baseline on top-5 prompt sets, and p50 latency change <=10% when optimizations are applied. Alerts should surface failing examples and a small sample of inputs.

Kevin: A couple of customer asks to call out — AcmeHealth needs per-model affinity and an explicit opt-out flag. Dedicated customers require policy mapping to ensure suggestions honor reserved capacity.

Anya: Policy mapping is high-value but also scope risk. Suggest we include a simple mapping schema and treat full policy automation as a stretch goal (interface stub in MVP, implementation post-alpha).

Devin: Agree. We can ship the schema + two hardcoded mappings (hosted vs dedicated) initially to unblock pilots.

Julia: For the eval-alert config, proposing a simple schema example so ops can review.

```yaml
alert:
  name: "response-drift"
  metric: "quality.delta"
  window: "7d"
  threshold_pct: 3.0
  sample_size: 1000
  notify: ["oncall", "pm"]
  attach_examples: true
```

Kevin: UX notes — surface recommendations in Console + API. Console card should show: estimated cost savings, predicted latency delta, confidence score, and a one-click 'apply recommendation' flow (which will open a service ticket for dedicated customers).

Anya: Draft launch checklist (alpha->pilot): 1) 3 pilot customers committed, 2) docs + runbook, 3) E2E tests for batching/cache/quant paths, 4) SLI for alert false-positive rate <10%, 5) clear rollback path if quality regresses.

Devin: Owners and immediate next steps: Devin -> runtime for batching heuristics and CLI rollout flag; Julia -> eval hooks, threshold tuning, test harness; Kevin -> Console cards + API surfaces; Anya -> PM + customer coordination. Target alpha in 4 weeks (handful of customers).

Sarah: Customer-success asks — can we include a per-customer opt-in toggle in Console? AcmeHealth insists on explicit opt-in before any recommendations are applied.

Anya: Yes. Add opt-in toggle (console + API). Mark as non-blocking for alpha if default is opt-out, but must be present before pilot.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: optimize-signal-bridge/alpha -> staging at 1807654380 by @deployer

Devin: Noted. I'll push a PR with the CLI flag and a minimal mapping schema today, and post links here when ready.

Anya: Great — please @-mention any blockers in this thread. We'll collate into a short spec doc and share with the pilot customers. :thumbsup:
